steps.text: Meanwhile, Saga, the wandering monk from Higashi, sets out from Baizao, traveling leisurely to the southwest.

After traveling over a hundred li, she looks back and can no longer see the Yanese capital, neither its silhouette nor the ruts from its traffic. As dusk falls, she suddenly sees houses, partly obscured, to the south.
As she gets closer, she sees an abandoned village: the houses are collapsed, weeds and trees are growing unchecked, wells and channels are clogged, and thick moss carpets the doorways.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: This house looks still intact... and it even has a little garden.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Though the village is now abandoned, look how carefully the roads and houses were laid out. It must have been a prosperous settlement once.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I wonder how it was ruined... Catastrophe? Navigated off course? An issue with the Chidao? Something else?

The spring breeze is gentle and chilly. The cold light of the twin moons streams through the old window, casting grid-like shadows before Saga's feet. They overlap with the blurrier shadows of nearby trees, blending into a mottled pattern of light and shade.

Saga leans beneath the window, reflecting on the turning seasons and the impermanence of human affairs. Absentmindedly, she reaches to touch the shadow, and just as her fingertips meet the ground, she hears a strange sound—
The shadow under her fingers seems to shake along with her.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh... I was so occupied with looking at the house that I forgot to eat.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: The people of Baizao really know how to honor their food. There are so many varieties of dried provisions, and I purchased almost each one of them! Which should I taste first?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Even the plainest seasoned instant food smell delicious, and there's also coarse multi-grain meal, vacuum-packed tofu wraps, and self-heating mixed mushroom rice...
Saga mutters to herself as she listens intently to the sounds outside the wall. She stays pinned against the wall under the window as she quietly strafes toward the door.
Just as she's about to step outside, her movements are interrupted by two knocks.
S-Sorry for disturbing you.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: No disturbance at all. The doors and windows here are nothing but frames. Since thou art willing to talk with this humble servant of Buddha, please show thyself.
The footsteps on the other side of the wall pause for a moment.

Then, a hand grips the door frame, the wrist bathed in moonlight as white as snow. A youthful Feline girl steps in, her skirt rustling softly. She is almond-eyed with jet-black hair, with a faint hint of shyness on her face.
Saga's nostrils flare slightly—a faint fragrance of pea blossoms. Strange. She hadn't noticed any pea vines left in this abandoned garden...

steps.name: Feline Girl
steps.text: Have you... come here from Baizao?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Well guessed. I am of Higashi, but I wandered to Yan long ago and left Baizao just a few days past.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Art thou... the master of this place?

steps.name: Feline Girl
steps.text: Huh? You can tell at a glance that it's been abandoned for a while. How could I possibly live here?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I had the same thought. Is there not typically some kind of diversion that turns rubble into grand halls, dewdrops into fine dishes, and the sound of wind into music?

steps.name: Feline Girl
steps.text: Diversion?

steps.name: Feline Girl
steps.text: Wait a minute. Who do you take me for?! I'm the daughter of a respectable family. I'm just passing through and staying here for the night, same as you!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah. Thou hast come from Shangshu. Lost thy way on the road to Baizao? This is what bringest thou to spend the night in this place?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Good guess. My family name is Yuan, and we have always lived at the foot of Zuanjiang Peak. You may call me Xiaoyu.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I'm indeed on my way to the capital. I'm going to the Tianshi Bureau to find a Tianshi who... has been kind to my family.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah, thou seekest the capital to pay a debt of gratitude?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: 'Pay a debt of gratitude'? I wouldn't go that far. It's just that... my family is wealthy, so they were targeted by bandits. One of the Tianshis happened to be passing through and saved my family's lives.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: My father and mother are both people who value gratitude, and they appreciated the Tianshi's kindness. Since it was New Year's, they sent a letter, along with some local specialties, to convey their thanks.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: But they received no reply. They don't know if the package got lost in the mail or not. My parents are getting on in age. I didn't want them to worry about this, so I decided to go to Baizao and thank the Tianshi in person.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I never imagined that as I neared Baizao, I wouldn't even be able to see the city...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I see. Baizao is on the march this month. I suspect thou hast ventured to the wrong stop? I made the same mistake myself on the road to Jiangqi.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: On the march? Hmm... I know I should not ask this, since you just left Baizao... but... it's the first time I've ever left my home, and finding Baizao on my own has been such a difficult task...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: If it wouldn't delay your journey, sister, would you take me to Baizao so I might seek an audience at the Tianshi Bureau? As long as I can get there, I shall empty my purse to you in thanks!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: (Xiaoyu truly is a Shangshu gentlewoman. She speaks in such proper, formal tones. It is most fortunate I am already so accustomed to Yan, or I might struggle to understand her...)

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: This would not delay me! I am but a wandering monk with no fixed itinerary. I left Baizao but a few days ago, it would require very little effort to turn around and catch the city. Let me escort you to the capital—no need for compensation.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: How could I possibly accept that, dear sister? Ever since I was little, my parents taught me that 'every kindness deserves a thanks'. If you hadn't agreed to take me along with you, I'd be lost in the wilderness, my very life at risk...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I simply have to repay a great kindness like that.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Is there anything you're particularly fond of, sister? Is there anything you might need on your travels?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: No. I have everything I—

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: You keep refusing my offers, sister. Is it because you don't believe I am sincere in expressing my gratitude?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah! Perish the thought, it is a simple fact that I have always lived on my own, in humble poverty, with all that I have being all that I need.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: (Why do I feel that this Xiaoyu girl is a bit strange...?)

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Are you saying, sister, that you still don't believe me? You think I'm some kind of poltergeist from the mountains?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Why dost thou speak such things? I would never... I certainly...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Then, *sniff* sister, you must think I'm overthinking...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Well... uhh... upon our arrival at Baizao, thou mayest offer me a proper vegetarian meal.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Ah, so you are a foodie after all. I just heard you talking about dried provisions.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: It is because I heard thine stomach rumbling...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: You heard that?! And you're telling me you heard it?! Aiya...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Why don't you speak, sister?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I am in fear of once again speaking wrongly.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Sorry... That's my fault. Ever since I was little, I've had this habit of talking back. Even the neighbor girl used to scold me for it—once she got so flustered she almost threw away my... what was it again...?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I'm rambling too much. In any case, I'm sorry, sister.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah... aiyo...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, wouldst thou enjoy some dried provisions with me?
A few days later...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Sister, my feet ache...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: No matter. Noon is almost upon us. Let us stop and rest for a spell.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I wonder if I will be allowed to visit the Tianshi Bureaus when I get to Baizao.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: With a proper reason to request an audience, thou needst only follow the rules and register. To my understanding, thine Tianshi seems a kind, upstanding woman—she would not turn away a caller.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Yes. It's just that I'm worried it might be hard to even get word to her, or that my trivial request won't even be passed along at all...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: If only I had skills like yours, sister... After these days traveling together, I've realized you're not only kind-hearted, but also highly skilled in the martial arts—truly impressive.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: The martial arts are for self-defense alone. There are many challenges in our world they cannot solve.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: A woman like you, sister monk, with such martial skill, can of course say that. But for us ordinary folk, we just hope for a bit more strength so we are better prepared for challenges when they arise.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: If I hadn't been so young, if I'd had skills of my own, would I have needed the Tianshi's kindness just to keep my family safe?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: (So Xiaoyu's family was attacked by bandits when she was a child...?)

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Thine words, Xiaoyu, have given me an idea.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: If thou harborest such admiration for this Tianshi's skills, why not challenge the examination at the Tianshi Bureaus? Shouldst thou master her Arts, thou couldst protect more than just thy family.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: —Me? How could I ever...?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Excuse my poor manners. What I meant to say was, 'I will consider your advice, dear sister...'

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Say, our kettle of water is empty. Since we're already taking a break, why don't we boil some water before continuing on?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Sister, could I trouble you to light the fire? I'm ashamed to admit that I always fear fire, though I know it's crucial to people who travel across the wilderness...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: As for me, I'll go get some water. I remember we passed a creek just now.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, didst thou not speak of foot pain?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Yes, I did. Sister, may I rub your ears a moment? When I was small and went on outings with my brother, I'd get tired and cry, and he'd let me touch his ears—it was soothing.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah... I fear that would be somewhat...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Haha, I was just teasing, sister. Very good, then. I'm going now.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Ah, there are dandelions by the creek here. I think I'll pick some. We've got the fire going—there's no point in just boiling water.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: There are some more on the other side of the creek...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Ah. The stream narrows down here, and there's a stone I can step on...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Huh? Why is the stone moving?!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Wah! It's a giant gloompincer!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Sister! Help me! Save me!
Don't panic.
Wait, you are...
Never mind. First I need to—
Ah! My feet——!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Ah! It's pinching your feet!

steps.name: Young Boy
steps.text: Thank you for saving me!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah. It was nothing! But, young man, why didst thou drag the gloompincer's carcass with you?

steps.name: Young Boy
steps.text: Huh? We can get the claw and belly meat out while it's still fresh! Otherwise, it'll just go to waste! Haha!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: What? This giant gloompincer is... edible?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Of course it is! Sorry. I still haven't introduced myself. My family name is Li. I'm studying agriculture at the Tianshi Bureaus.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: This gloompincer may be big, but it has the same internal composition as any other gloompincer. If we can extract meat from the small ones, then this one is no different.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Weren't you already boiling water? I only came over because I saw the smoke from your fire—I never expected to find this young lady in danger.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: A Tianshi?!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah, Tianshi Li, my apologies for not greeting you more properly. I am called Saga. I hail from Higashi. Today, I travel across Yan.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: My name is... Yuan Yu. I'm from Shangshu. I got lost on my way to the capital, but luckily, this sister was there to guide me.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Tianshi Li, are you also on your way to Baizao? Are you perhaps on your way back to the Tianshi Bureaus?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Ah. That's right. I left the capital to acquire some special 'strain samples', and now I'm on my way back. If you're also going to Baizao, then shall we go together?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, thou art blessed with luck. The matter of thy concern... Perhaps Tianshi Li may assist?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Hmm? What is it?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Oh. It's nothing, just a minor issue. I'll tell you about it once we reach Baizao!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Tianshi Li, the 'strain samples' you just mentioned, are they your wondrous 'devices', by any chance? Ever since I was little, I've read stories about the hundreds of different devices that Tianshis use, but I've never seen one with my own eyes...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Haha. I wouldn't call them wondrous devices. I've just... well I've been at the Tianshi Bureaus for all these years, and I've never seen any strain cultured this flawlessly... Let me show you!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: O-Oh... I was just being curious about the devices... I apologize for being uncouth!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: A rare occurrence to see Xiaoyu so brash...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: No trouble! But I really don't have any wondrous devices here, only this thing. Look, it's quite good—

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: This would appear to be a... moldy orange?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Yes! Look at this mold! Look how well it's growing! It's beautiful...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: This thing will rescue my schoolbrother's thesis...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Gah... uhh...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: What hast thou? Is it perhaps Tianshi Li's bag?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I wasn't trying to steal his money. I just wanted to borrow something for a little bit. I had every intention of returning it.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: This thing thou seekest to borrow, Xiaoyu, might it be an entry pass to the Tianshi Bureaus?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have pondered why thou toldest not Tianshi Li the purpose of thy journey. As thou fearest thy message may not reach the Tianshi you seek, would it not have been best to ask him to help find her?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, I believe thy goal has been and remains gaining access to the Tianshi Bureaus. To go so far as to steal into Tianshi Li's luggage...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Dare I ask thy true intentions on the Tianshis?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: The Tianshi thou seekst, what, in fact, is thy true relation to her?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: If you're asking these questions, then you already know the answer. Do you really need to ask?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Only a few things in this world would lead one to take such a risk to one's life.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: If not the repayment of a debt of kindness...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Then thou seekest revenge.
Saga reaches out her hand and touches Xiaoyu's forehead.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Be careful, little one.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I know you have a kind heart, sister, and will surely try to stop me. But that Tianshi killed my entire family. This is all I live for now: to make my enemy pay with her life, so my family can rest in peace!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, the Laws of Yan are strict indeed. If it be true that this Tianshi did harm, why not report it to the Three Organs of Justice? The legal system will surely grant thee justice—why risk thine own life?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I... but I don't even know her name. How would I even report the case?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Besides, officials hold power; commoners do not. All those storybooks are full of unsolved cases. Without the help of some extraordinary hero or honest magistrate, how could I ever win a case against a Tianshi? I'm just a girl, on my own.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: The murder of an entire family is a major case. The Three Organs of Justice would never turn a blind eye to something so grave, even without the killer's name. So long as there is evidence, even a Tianshi will face justice.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: But I don't have any evidence...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Then how dost thou know the Tianshi did it?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I... I remember her. I remember what she looked like!

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: And the blood... the blood flowed beneath my knees...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I awoke under a huge pile of rubble. My house was ruined and empty. I couldn't even find my family's corpses. All of this happened... after I met her...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Who else, other than that Tianshi, could have done it? If she didn't kill my family, who did?!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Thou knowest not the Tianshi's name, then, when didst thou meet her? As a child, or as an adult? Didst thou find her in the ruins, or in thy home?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Uhh... I think... it was...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I just know it was her! I just know it!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Didst thou witness her killing thy kin?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I was looking for her... and I saw... lots of dead people... and I was the only one left...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, I recall thine words, that there was nary a corpse to be found?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Their-their corpses... no... uhh... no...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ah, Xiaoyu, be not alarmed. It was not my place to so interrogate thee. Such a traumatizing experience has an affect on the memory, 'tis natural.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: How many... were in my family?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Was it eleven...?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Or five hundred?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, have thee remembered anything? Thou have been quiet for quite some time.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Pardon my forwardness, but wouldst thou tell me of thine origins?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: So you still suspect that I'm a poltergeist?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: My family name is Yuan. I live at the foot of Zuanjiang Peak with my mother, my father, my brother's family, and an elder sister. The banana plant by the window, I remember how many leaves it had. I remember it all! I know exactly where I came from... how could I...?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: But those bloody wastelands... what are...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: Sister! Pinch me, touch me—I'm warm, my heart's still beating. I know hunger. I know thirst. I... I can't possibly be one of those monsters from the storybooks, right?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have had many strange encounters over the years... but never once have I seen any wandering souls or ghosts like those of strange tales. It seems there are no ghosts on this great land.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu, thou sayest thy memory is clear. What exactly dost thou remember?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I remember... it was like... I got separated from my family; I chased after them, but all I found was a bloody mess...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I remember I was born at the foot of Zuanjiang Peak. My family loved me. Ever since I was small, I'd had nary a care nor worry...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I loved to listen to stories... I often played with the girl who lived next door. She used to wear her hair in twin buns. On the fifth of May, when she turned nine, I gave her a five-colored hair ribbon...

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: There's something I treasured dearly... I kept it by the west window, on the desk, beside my dressing mirror... it was... it was...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: *Sigh*

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: A pea?
Li lets out another sigh. He takes a yellow talisman and puts it to 'Xiaoyu's' chest. The delicate strokes on the paper light up immediately, with a faint glow.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: What... what are you doing?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: The talisman works. This proves you're a product of the Tianshi Bureaus.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: You are a pea soldier.
A faint fragrance of pea blossoms.
At the foot of 'Zuanjiang Peak'.

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: ...I've had this habit of talking back. Even the neighbor girl used to scold me for it—once she got so flustered she almost threw away my... what was it again...?

steps.name: Xiaoyu
steps.text: I'm ashamed to admit that I always fear fire...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: ...I felt an unease at her story, but... a pea soldier...?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: This is the Tianshi's 'Legion of the Scattered Peas' technique. During particularly busy times at the Agricultural Bureau, they'll sometimes conjure a squad of pea soldiers to help out.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: But... come to think of it, the pea soldiers usually all look the same. They don't have consciousness or memory, and they aren't active for very long. They definitely wouldn't think they have families or personal histories.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: The talisman confirmed she's a pea soldier; that's not in doubt—but for her to look like this, and carry such mixed-up memories, something strange must have happened to her.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: 'Mixed-up memories'? Indeed. Her memories are most muddled. However, I believed it was merely owed to the trauma she has...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I got up early today and heard most of your conversations. You two were making quite a lot of noise...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Sure, the Nongye Tianshis use pea soldiers for chores—but the technique's name is 'Legion of the Scattered Peas'. That tells you what it was really meant for: warfare.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I heard Xiaoyu mention getting 'separated from her family'. I think she got separated from the rest of the pea soldiers when the Tianshi summoned them and had to run to catch up with them.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: The 'bloody mess' she mentioned, I think, was the battlefield she was summoned to. Perhaps she arrived late and saw only the post-battle carnage, and all the blood scared her back into pea form.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Typically, the Arts wear off after a few days, and the pea soldiers return to dust.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: But I have no idea how you ended up in the hands of that Yuan girl... maybe someone cleaning up the battlefield picked you up and gave you to her?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I don't know how the girl kept you, but somehow, a lingering trace of the Arts remained in the pea, affecting your consciousness...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: You kept saying how you love to listen to stories. I bet that Yuan girl loved to read storybooks, and she read to you every day, right?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I'll guess you want to go to the capital because that's what everyone does when they run into trouble in the storybooks, yeah?

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: No. It's probably because... Xiaoyu married her neighbor. He passed the imperial examination, and she went to the capital with him...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I had just... forgotten that part.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Oho! That actually makes sense. You're quite the storyteller—your memories might be scattered, but you still managed to weave all these bits into a narrative!

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: Then why… why do I look like Xiaoyu now? Aren't pea soldiers supposed to be without memories or consciousness?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: What surprises me more is that even though you had already reverted to a pea, under the care of Xiaoyu, you managed to transform into her form. How? And you managed to live this long, with such a strong consciousness...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: If I hadn't confirmed that you were a Tianshi product with the talisman, just judging by your looks and your behavior, I'd have thought you were...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Uhh... forget it. I'd rather not say.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: (...Zuanjiang Peak—if I recall correctly, last time I encountered Dusk and Mr. Lee at Rhodes Island, they mentioned this exactly place...)

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: At any rate, I'm afraid you've mistaken yourself for the Yuan Yu girl and mixed up a bunch of memories into one strange, singular narrative. You thought you were going to the capital on a mission of vengeance.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: ...so I really wasn't... how could that be...?

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: This grievance... can never be avenged?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: That's a good thing! Isn't it?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Tianshi Li, I have one more question to ask thee.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Given Xiaoyu's true origins, how will the Tianshi Bureaus choose to deal with her?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I know what you mean to say, Saga, but she is a product of the Tianshis, and a unique one at that. We cannot let her roam freely.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: Tianshi Li, may I make one more request?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: What else could you ask? That whole story of yours, I explained to you what it all really is. It never happened. You just stitched it together yourself.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I don't mean to impose. I just want to ask, before we go to the Tianshi Bureaus, can I visit someone first?

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I may have made all this up, but I wasn't born from nothing.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: You said that if it hadn't been for that girl raising me, I would have been reduced to dust on a bloody battlefield, right? I'm standing right here, alive and well, so at least that part is true.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: But I haven't even spoken to her once.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: If you go meet her as you are now... that wouldn't be very good would it? Do you really have to insist on this?

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I can cover myself up. I won't tell her what I am. I will just say thank you.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: 'Every kindness deserves a thanks'...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Tianshi Li, as the saying goes, 'Men are not grass and trees, how can they be without a heart?' This is Xiaoyu's only wish. Can we indeed be more heartless than the very plants of the field?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I urge thee to grant her request.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Ah... umm...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: *Sigh*!

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: 'Here lies Yuan Yu, a beloved mother'...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: It's been... so long ago... I didn't know...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: No wonder the whole estate was in ruins when I woke up...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I thought at least one of my memories wasn't fabricated...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: But I was wrong.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu...

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: Duoxie, sister.

steps.name: 'Xiaoyu'
steps.text: I can't... repay anyone's kindness.
As soon as she finishes speaking, a faint light appears. It's not too bright, but Saga closes her eyes.
When she opens them, all she sees is a pea in her palm, its surface as hard as jade.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Tianshi Li, I have another question.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Did we... truly meet by chance? Do Tianshi apprentices always carry such talismans?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: ...*sighs* It's a product of the Tianshi Bureau. How could I not know of it, being so close to the capital here?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: The two of you met here by chance, so I thought maybe I should let you finish your journey, and then when you part ways, I'll sneak in and take her back to the Bureaus...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Thou knewest of the girl Yuan Yu for some time?

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Actually, no. I just knew that this pea soldier could never fulfill her wish.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: It's been a hundred years since the last time there was a war in Shangshu and the Tianshis marched on the battlefield.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Pea soldiers have neither consciousness nor memories, and yet this one became self-aware, with her own 'struggle', her own 'adventure'...

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: She trudged all that way, from Shangshu to Baizao, enduring so many hardships, only to find that it was all... nothing.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: What was the point?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Someone once told me that when we look at paintings, we think we are 'real people' looking at 'unreal people', but who is to say we are not the ones in the painting, our lives being drawn by some unseen hand?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: There are many days when I think of those words, including this one.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Thou sayest that Xiaoyu traveled so far and suffered so much, only to discover it was all nothing.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: And yet, I think...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: It was not necessarily 'nothing'.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: However you want to put it, it doesn't change the ending.

steps.name: Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: What can you do to change it?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Xiaoyu gave herself a story—and for that story, she journeyed a thousand li. As this humble servant of Buddha accompanied her part of the way, I shall...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: ...Record this story.
